issue.author: dyung
issue.body:
One of our internal tests started hitting an assertion failure which I was able to bisect back to commit 4d60c6d. Here is the reduced test case:
```c
#define a(b) safe_##b
struct c {
  short d
};
char k;
int e;
volatile struct c f;
void a(add_func_int16_t_s_s)();
void g(char h) {
  int i;
  short j = k = 7;
  for (; k; safe_add_func_int16_t_s_s()) {
    for (; j > 1; j = -1) {
      for (; i; i++)
        ;
      e = h;
      f;
    }
    if (h)
      break;
  }
}
```
When built with optimizations (`-O3`) and a compiler that includes 4d60c6d, we hit an assertion failure:
